name: Contact details
description: The ways to reach a business without a form: email and phone as mailto:/tel: links, the postal address in an <address>, opening hours and a map link, as a list or in columns. Renders nothing when every detail is empty.

layout.description: list: one detail under another. columns: side by side on wide screens (a contact band under a map or above the footer).

email.label: Email
email.description: The address people write to; shown as a mailto: link.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: The number as it should be read; the tel: link drops spaces and punctuation.

address.label: Address
address.description: Postal address, one line per line.

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.description: Opening hours, one line per day or range.

mapUrl.label: Map link
mapUrl.description: A map of the address (Google Maps, OpenStreetMap), shown as a link under it.

a11y: A description list: each detail is named by its term. Email and phone are real links that say what they are; the address is an <address>. The section is labelled by its heading.

pattern.summary: email, phone, address and hours listed, no form
